articles.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
articles.description: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

articles.title: NVIDIAをつくった男、ジェンスン・フアン “デニーズの皿洗い“から“AI時代の主役“へ、激動の半生
articles.description: ダイナーの一角から、AI時代の主役「NVIDIA」を生み出したジェンスン・フアン氏。“皿洗い”から億万長者へと至った半生を振り返る。

articles.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
articles.description: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

articles.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
articles.description: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
articles.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

articles.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
articles.description: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
articles.description: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

articles.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
articles.description: ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises.

articles.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
articles.description: Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.

articles.title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
articles.description: Huang described Kress as a "deer in the headlights" during a meeting in summer.

articles.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
articles.description: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

articles.title: Googleの社内専用コーディングAI「GfG」、その全容 Geminiに社内データ1兆トークン学習させ開発 所要時間半減の業務も
articles.description: 米Googleなどに所属する研究者らが10月に発表した論文「Customizing an LLM for Enterprise Software Engineering」は、AIに企業独自の膨大な開発データを学習させ、社内システム開発に特化したコーディングモデルを構築する手法とその実用効果をまとめた研究報告だ。

articles.title: 「AI処理、データ非保持が守られず」――Notionが委託先の問題指摘、漏えいの恐れ巡り
articles.description: クラウド型ワークスペース「Notion」のAI機能「Notion AI」のチャット記録が漏えいした恐れがある事案を巡り、Notion運営の米Notion Labsは、法人向けプランでZDR（ゼロデータ保持）を利用するーユーザーでも漏えいした可能性があることを明らかにした。
